jobs.summary: Deploy generate-flashcards so it honours noCache (live is v9, repo has it)
jobs.why: A personal AI deck must not be written into the shared cache. The suffixed personalDeckKey() already protects the shared row on v9, so nothing is broken meanwhile — this removes the stray cache row a personal generation leaves behind. Do NOT remove the key suffix when deploying this.
jobs.verify: get_edge_function generate-flashcards → version > 9, and its source contains `noCache`. Then: generate a personal deck from a chapter's + menu and confirm no new row appears in `flashcards` with a `#own-` deck_key.

jobs.summary: Delete the empty `note-images` storage bucket from the Supabase dashboard
jobs.why: It was created for a synced-notes design that was reversed the same hour: study notes are on-device only. Its four RLS policies are already dropped and it holds zero objects, so nothing can reach it and nothing is at risk — but an empty private bucket is a thing every future reader has to reason about before concluding it is dead. SQL cannot remove it (storage.protect_delete blocks direct deletion); it needs the Storage API or the dashboard's Buckets page.
jobs.verify: select count(*) from storage.buckets where id='note-images' returns 0.
